name: 章を途中まで表示して全文へ進む
prompt: Make one correction to the 390×440 chapter-list screen: compress the five chapter rows to the native vertical anchors and flatten the green button. Preserve the canvas, heading, text size, x-positions, labels and button geometry. In native 390×440 coordinates, keep the heading near y12; chapter-title rows near y56, y116, y176, y236 and y296; keep the button at approximately x20, y376, width350, height44. The current candidate expands row pitch to about 65px; restore the native 60px rhythm so the fifth row leaves the original gap above the button. Change the button to uniform flat forest green (#047857), with no gradient, texture, highlight or shadow. Keep all other surfaces white, chapter titles near-black, numbers neutral gray. Preserve exact text and order: 章の一覧; 1 第1章：心が居場所を知った場所; 2 第2章：言葉を使わずに語る土地; 3 第3章：顔と声、つながりの心; 4 第4章：時間と記憶に響くもの; 5 第5章：山々の間に刻まれた夢; すべて表示. First image is exact layout/copy authority, second is the candidate to correct, third is palette only. No tint colors, extra UI, or added copy.
reviewNotes: White page and neutral text remove tint; row rhythm is closer. Mild green action tonal variation remains for owner review.
